statement: Community descriptor/Explorer and VIIPER report mapping document 64-byte USB 0x01: six 8-bit stick/analog-trigger axes at 1..6, sequence byte 7, button/hat fields, signed 16-bit gyro/accelerometer, sensor timestamp, two four-byte touch contacts and battery/charging status. Each contact encodes a 7-bit ID plus inactive bit 0x80 and packed 12-bit X/Y; physical sensor data and serial are not published.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: nondebug README.md 99-148, USB descriptor; Explorer parser; VIIPER docs 83-102; Linux 244-267. Community/compatible model; not an authenticated retail packet trace.
